workarounds.symptom: addons/godot_mcp fails to compile (CS0104) when the consuming project enables ImplicitUsings
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: consumer builds — guarded catalog embed (#511) and ImplicitUsings-safe addon (#474). Target files: Godot-MCP.Tests/ImplicitUsingsAmbiguityTests.cs, addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Reload/ReloadGateDriver.cs, addons/godot_mcp/Editor/Rql/EditorApi/RqlEditorApi.Project.cs. Fixes two consumer build breaks, both reproduced locally on the latest release (0.39.3). (Ref: https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP/pull/520)

workarounds.symptom: install-plugin writes an unconditional <EmbeddedResource>, so a clone that gitignores addons/ fails to build (CS1566)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cli): guard the addon's EmbeddedResource with Exists() so a gitignored addons/ still builds. Target files: cli/src/utils/csproj-deps.ts, cli/tests/csproj-deps.test.ts. `install-plugin` writes the addon's `<EmbeddedResource>` with no `Condition`. The catalog lives inside `addons/`, which is per-checkout material (the addon ships as source), so a consumer that gitignores the addon dir — or a fresh clone — fails the build with CS1566: (Ref: https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP/pull/512)

workarounds.symptom: `filesystem-reimport` reports success for native `.tscn` scenes despite Godot import errors
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(tools): stop reporting success for no-op reimports and Variant/Node reflection calls. Target files: .github/assetlib/edit.hbs, Godot-MCP.Tests/Godot-MCP.Tests.csproj, Godot-MCP.Tests/ReflectionArgumentGuardTests.cs. Two silent-failure bugs (the "reports success while doing nothing" class), the node-ordering feature, and a documented deferral. (Ref: https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Godot-MCP/pull/321)
